metadata.title: FTSE 100 Leadership Pressure Radar

rosterSource.name: Wikipedia FTSE 100 constituent table
rosterSource.note: Used only as a reproducible public constituent snapshot; FTSE Russell remains the index authority.

profitWarningCoverage.definition: A qualifying event is an official issuer announcement that either cuts full-year earnings guidance or quantifies a material prospective adverse impact on profit. Routine earnings misses, unquantified caution, and reductions to operating metrics without a clear profit implication are excluded.
profitWarningCoverage.scoreTreatment: Displayed as a source-verified overlay and excluded from the pressure score pending calibration and outcome testing.

successionCoverage.definition: An active succession case requires an official issuer announcement that an incumbent CEO or Chair will leave, that a search is underway, or that a named successor has not yet taken office.
successionCoverage.scoreTreatment: Displayed as a source-verified status and excluded from the pressure score.

scoreDefinition.label: Leadership transition pressure
scoreDefinition.ceo: Tenure pressure rises over a ten-year reference horizon, capped at 80 points.
scoreDefinition.chair: Tenure pressure rises toward the UK Code's nine-year chair independence and succession reference point, capped at 80 points.
scoreDefinition.dissent: Up to 20 additional points reflect verified 20%+ dissent on management-sponsored resolutions in the existing tracker window. Shareholder proposals are excluded.
scoreDefinition.profitWarnings: Qualifying official issuer events are shown as an evidence overlay but do not yet alter the score.
scoreDefinition.succession: Officially announced active CEO and Chair succession processes are shown as a status overlay but do not alter the score.

limitations: This is a research prioritisation score, not a prediction that an individual will leave office.
All 100 companies have source-verified leadership records in methodology 0.6; externally managed issuers without a chief executive are marked not applicable rather than scored.
The dissent uplift uses the narrow 2025 significant-dissent dataset and is not a complete voting-history measure.
The profit-warning review covers 100 of 100 source-verified companies; a no-event outcome means no qualifying issuer announcement was identified under the stated definition and review window.
Succession status reflects official announcements found by the evidence date and may change between refreshes.
Profit warnings do not yet affect the pressure score; share-price stress, activism, and broader news signals remain excluded.

calibration.note: All 50 completed-transition cases now have complete aligned warning windows. The locked evaluation sample still shows no incremental capture from warning or performance uplifts, so production weights remain unchanged.
